text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=\"model-catalog\" reason=\"config-revision-mismatch\" route=default

pagerduty: Incident: PD-4872 assigned to sophia

sophia: acked on pagerduty, looking

dan: on it too. quick summary?

sophia: alert says active route 'default' reports tokens failing at runtime, config shows revision 3 but runtime hash is rev-4. Some requests returning tokenizer errors and 5xx.

jess: seeing spikes in 5xx for a few customers seeding long sequences. sample error: `TokenizerError: Unknown token id 50255` repeated.

sophia: hmm. likely model revision mismatch + tokenizer vocab change. Could be a bad rollout where rev-4 was promoted without compatible tokenizer.

dan: any customer impact numbers?

jess: quick look: metrics dashboard shows 4.1k requests in last 10m to route=default, 6.8% 5xx. Top tenants: tenant-42 (1.2k reqs), tenant-ops (800).

sophia: tagging severity=P2 for now until we get rollback in. Notifying SRE. :eyes:

sre-oncall: joining. can we pin route to previous revision while we investigate?

sophia: recommended mitigation: pin to rev-3 and re-route traffic to fallback model-variant (vocab-compatible). Steps: 1) set route.pin=rev-3 2) disable auto-promote for catalog 3) create rollback job.

dan: CLI to pin: `redwoodctl routes set --route default --pin-rev rev-3 --reason \"emergency rollback: tokenizer mismatch\"`

jess: running a dry-run first to confirm route exists.

jess: ```
$ redwoodctl routes get --route default --format json
{"route":"default","active_rev":"rev-4","pinned_rev":null}
```

sophia: ok that matches. please pin and watch for errors to drop.

jess: running pin now...```
$ redwoodctl routes set --route default --pin-rev rev-3 --reason \"emergency rollback: tokenizer mismatch\" --force
Applying pin to route default -> rev-3
Rolling back dynamic traffic to rev-3
Operation queued: op-8921
```

jess: pin applied, op-8921 started.

sophia: good. monitoring logs and SLOs.

(5m later)

jess: metrics update: overall 5xx rate dropped to 1.2% after pin. tenant-42 failures mostly resolved.

dan: nice. did we also disable the promotion pipeline?

sophia: yes, I set `catalog.auto_promote=false` for the model id. command: `redwoodctl catalog update --model md-201 --auto-promote false --reason \"investigate tokenizer compatibility\"`

product-ops-bot: Statuspage update draft created: \"Partial outage for model-catalog default route; mitigated with rollback. We are investigating root cause.\"

sre-oncall: recommend we open an internal incident doc and tag ops. I'll create one and assign follow-ups: root cause, root-cause-analysis, postmortem.

sophia: creating incident ticket INC-2026 and linking op-8921. Adding notes: pinned to rev-3, disabled auto-promote, flagged rev-4 for model-revision review.

dan: who promoted rev-4? we need a timeline and the CI job that triggered the promotion.

jess: grabbing audit logs: `GET /internal/catalog/audit?model=md-201&from=1938456000` returns promoter=ci-deploy-bot job=deploy-6212 at 1938456120.

sophia: tagging release-engineering and model-onboarding.

mike: i'm up in 25m; if this is still open i'll take the incident handoff.

sophia: thanks — i'll do a handoff at +25. current status: mitigation applied, customer errors reduced, next steps: RCA, fix promotion gating (tokenizer compatibility check), add canary run w/ tokenizer smoke tests.

product-ops-bot: Notifying affected customers: tenant-42, tenant-ops. Email templates queued.

sophia: adding brief to execs: short summary + mitigation + ETA for RCA (48h).

dan: one more: let's add an automated check to preflight: compare tokenizer.vocab.hash between candidate rev and active rev and block promotion if mismatch. I'll file a PR.

sophia: thanks all. leaving notes and shifting to monitoring. handoff to mike in 25. :thumbsup: 

(25m later)
sophia: handing off to mike — incident pinned, mitigation in place, ops + release eng notified, incident ticket INC-2026 assigned to mike for RCA coordination. :white_check_mark:

mike: ack. I have ops access and will coordinate postmortem. I'll update the ticket and schedule RCA meeting.

pagerduty: PD-4872 status: acknowledged -> resolved (auto-resolve after mitigation)

incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging, keeping channel for follow-ups.\"
